title: Tanzanian Sweet Potato Balls
author: Mama Salima
desc: Tanzanian Sweet Potato Balls — mashed sweet potato mixed with coconut milk, cardamom, and a little flour, rolled into balls and deep-fried until golden. A naturally sweet, naturally colourful coastal street snack — the orange of the sweet potato glowing through the golden crust.
longDesc: Sweet potato balls are the coastal street snack that uses Tanzania's most nutritious staple — the mashed sweet potato produces a naturally sweet, naturally orange ball that fries beautifully and is as nutritious as it is delicious.
steps: Mix in coconut milk, flour, sugar, cardamom, and salt.
The mixture should be firm enough to roll into balls.
Fry in batches 3—4 minutes until golden.
chefTips: Completely smooth mash — lumps create weak points that split during frying.
Chilling before frying firms the balls.
cookingScience: See TZA196 for sweet potato cooking science.
sustainabilityTips: Sweet potato is highly nutritious and climate-resilient.
healthBenefits: Natural sweetness — no added sugar needed.
culturalNote: Sweet potato balls are the coastal market's most colourful snack — the bright orange interior revealed when you bite through the golden crust is Tanzania's most nutritious colour.
